lines.text: A fugitive from Jerusalem tells Ezekiel the city has been taken, and the LORD opens Ezekiel's mouth before he arrives.
The people in the ruins say they are many, so the land has surely been given to them.
Those in the ruins die by the sword, those in the field by wild animals, those in caves by famine.
Ezekiel's people talk about him near the city gates, and they hear his words but do not practice them.
To them Ezekiel is a singer of love songs, and they will know a prophet was among them.
